en.topic_title: Hong Kong court jails repeat sex offender for 4 months over indecent assault of teenage girl on bus
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong court has jailed a repeat sex offender for four months over an indecent assault of a teenage girl on a double-decker bus two months ago.



West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts in Hong Kong, on September 19, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



William Wu, 65, was sentenced at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday, according to local media. He previously pleaded guilty to one count of indecent assault.
